triggers.name: sms_received
triggers.title: New SMS received
triggers.help: Checks for new SMSes every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes. When recipe is first started, trigger will pick up SMSes received an hour before recipe start time.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: To
input.label: Phone number
input.hint: Select the Twilio phone number receiving the SMS

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Twilio action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Twilio connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: get_media
actions.title: Get media from MMS
actions.description: Get media from MMS message via Twilio
actions.help: Retrieve list of media sent in an MMS. Identify the MMS via its message SID.

input.name: sid
input.label: Message SID
input.hint: SID of MMS to retrieve media for

input.name: From
input.label: From
input.hint: Select Twilio phone number to call from

input.name: To
input.label: To
input.hint: Phone number to call, inclusive of country code, e.g. +16505551212

input.name: Body
input.label: Message
input.hint: Message to be vocalized. Maximum 1286 characters.
